# reference value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:referenceValue`](gmeow-referenceValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/referenceValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Exactly one identifier string of the cadastral reference (e.g. 'Lot 42, Plan 12345', 'Folio 67890', 'Title No. ABCD-1234'). Functional: a single [`CadastralReference`](../classes/gmeow-CadastralReference.md) has exactly one reference value.
